buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank.

4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Inspection Pre-dispatch inspection at Seller premises (Fee/Charges to be borne by the BUYER): Before dispatch, the goods will be inspected by Buyer / Consignee or their Authorized Representative or by Nominated External Inspection Agency (independently or jointly with Buyer or Consignee as decided by the Buyer) at Seller premises (or at designated place for inspection as declared / communicated by the seller) for their compliance to the contract specifications. Fee/Charges taken by the External inspection Agency and any external laboratories testing charges shall be borne by the Buyer. For in-house testing, the Sellers will provide necessary facilities free of cost. Seller shall notify the Buyer through e-mail about readiness of goods for pre-dispatch inspection and Buyer will notify the Seller about the Authorized Representative/ Nominated External Inspection Agency and the date for testing. The goods would be dispatched to consignee only after clearance in pre-dispatch inspection. Consignee's right of rejection as per GTC in respect of the goods finally received at his location shall in no way be limited or waived by reason of the goods having previously been inspected, tested and passed by Buyer/ Consignee or its Nominated External Inspection Agency prior to the goods' shipment. While bidding, the sellers should take into account 7 days for inspection from the date of email offering the goods for inspection. Any delay in inspection beyond 7 days shall be on the part of the buyer and shall be regularised without Liquidated Damages. When there is requirement of submission the advance sample, the seller shall inform the buyer promptly through emails about the date of submission of sample to the buyer nominated Inspection agency. 6. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions 1. Submission of BHEL Technical Specifications, ITB, QAP/SQP (if uploaded in the NIT) and PQC Do cuments (If applicable) duly filled, signed & stamped is mandatory. Same shall be attached while submitting the Bid. 2. No Commercial Terms & Conditions including the Price validity shall be quoted in the Offer. All t he Terms & Conditions (including Price validity) shall be as per GEM Terms & Conditions only. Ter ms & Conditions quoted elsewhere will be summarily ignored and no claim against this will be e ntertained afterwards. 3. Bidders may note that Deviation to the NIT terms are not allowed in GEM, since there is no scop e of loading in the GEM and submission of the Bid implies that Bidder is accepting all the Terms & Conditions as per NIT that includes BHEL GEM ATC and GEM General Terms & Conditions. 4. Delivery Period: Delivery Period shall be as per GEM Enquiry only. Please submit your Quote co nsidering the Delivery Period as per Enquiry. BHEL at it’s own discretion may consider Delivery P eriod (as quoted in their Offer) other than GEM Enquiry or disqualify the Offer for not meeting th e Delivery requirement. 5. Offers insisting MOQ are liable for rejection. Quantity against each item shall be strictly as per E nquiry only. Offers quoting the Quantities other than Enquiry quantities cannot be considered an d such requests to change the quantities after releasing the PO will not be entertained. 6. Quantity Tolerance of +/- 10% on each item is acceptable for all the items. 7. Manufacturer Inspection/Test Certificate should be submitted by Supplier along with the Materia l and same shall be confirmed in the Technical Offer. 8. Clarifications if any shall be replied within the stipulated time and before the expiry. BHEL will pr oceed further without considering the Offer if clarifications are not replied within stipulated time as per GEM portal. 9. BHEL, at it’s own discretion, can cancel the part or full Enquiry at any stage of processing, befor e the placement of Purchase Order.

10. Length Requirement: Notwithstanding the length provisions specified in the applicable BHEL spe cification, all tubes against this tender shall be supplied in fixed lengths of 6.0 metres only. Rand om lengths or any length other than 6.0 metres shall not be acceptable. Wherever the applicable specification permits tube lengths of “not less than 4.5 metres” or any other range/random length, the specific requirement of fixed 6.0-metre length stipulated in this NIT shall prevail for this tender. The bidder shall quote accordingly. Submission of the offer shall be deemed as unconditional acc eptance of the above requirement. No deviation regarding tube length shall be entertained after bid submission. 11. Raw materials/Pipes shall not be sourced from China. After PO Instructions: 1. Material shall reach K-Gate of HPEP, BHEL, R C Puram. It is advised to reach in the earl y hours to avoid delay in Entry. Google location for the entry of the Material (BHEL K G ate) is https://maps.app.goo.gl/yELTzd6TgaxhB51w6. 2. Vendors shall follow the BHEL Standard Quality Plan (SQP) that was uploaded in the NIT, for manuf acturing the Ordered product. If any deviations/comments are applicable, same shall be noted on t he SQP and sent to BHEL for BHEL approval. BHEL SQP shall be uploaded in the CQIR portal for raising the Inspection call. If no SQP is uploaded in the NIT, then Quality Plan shall be submitted to BHEL within 3 days of Purchase Order for our approval. Approved Quality Plan is mandatory for star ting Manufacturing activities and same shall be presented to BHEL Third Party Inspection agency, during Inspection. It may take around One week time for QAP approval from the date of submissio n of QAP as per BHEL format and Vendors are advised to send the QAP as per standard format to a void the delay in QAP Approval. 3. Third Party Inspection (If applicable as per PO), shall be raised through the weblink http://cqir.bhel .in/Cqir/jsp/Masters/login.jsp. Vendors are requested to plan the Inspection date and raise the call a ccordingly in advance such that sufficient time is given to BHEL Third Party Inspector for visiting a s per their pending Inspection Calls. 4. Invoice shall be necessarily mentioned with BHEL Material code, BHEL SAP PO number and Unit of Measurement as per Purchase Order. LR shall be mentioned with Invoice number. 5. Delivery Challan (optional), LR (If applicable), Duplicate for Transporter Invoice, One set of Origina l Test Certificates shall accompany with the Driver and same shall be submitted at Designated stor es (Please refer the Purchase Order for the Store Number) 6. All the above specified Dispatch Documents shall be scanned and sent to the Purchase Officer thr ough email (venkateshm@bhel.in) along with Driver details, before the dispatch of the Material. En sure, email is received before receipt of the Material at BHEL K Gate. {Email shall be sent with PO number and Vehicle number as Email Subject line). 7. Original for Buyer Invoices in Three numbers, Original Test Certificates (If applicable), Original Ins pection Report/CQIR (If Applicable) along with TPIA reviewed documents shall be submitted directl y to the Purchase Officer through Courier/Post to the following address. Address: Venkatesh M, Dy. Manager/Purchase CMM, BHEL, R C Puram, Hyderabad, 502032. 8. Driver shall carry valid Vehicle License, Vehicle fitness certificate and ID Proof. 9. GST returns shall be filed periodically so that GST Payment can be processed as per the Payment due date. 10. Material receipt status and Progress of the Payment can be checked through PRADAN Portal (Webl ink: https://hpep.bhel.com/mm/). Login ID is the Supplier Code/Vendor code mentioned in the PO. 11. If this Purchase Order is released on Temporary Vendor code (Vendor code which starts with Num erical), please register with BHEL, by filling online registration form available in https://supplier.bhe l.in/).

12. If no acknowledgment is received within 15 days of this PO through Email, it is deemed that, Purch ase Order is accepted for execution. No amendments/corrections will be entertained afterwards. 13. Suppliers shall note that, Material shall be supplied strictly as per Ordered quantity only, within th e Tolerance limits. Material supplied beyond the Tolerance limits shall be rejected and same shall b e lifted from our Stores within 30 days of receipt of communication from BHEL. 14. If rejected Material is not lifted within 30 days of receipt of communication from BHEL, Material sh all be disposed to scrap yard and no claim for the Material return/Payment will be entertained afte rwards. 15. In case of any issue with regard to entry/unloading of the Material at BHEL, instruct the Vehicle dri ver to contact the Purchase Officer through Telephone @ 040 2318 4259 .
